SELECT AVG(t.total_clicks) FROM (SELECT T1.id_student, T1.code_module, T1.code_presentation, SUM(T2.sum_click) AS total_clicks FROM studentInfo AS T1 JOIN studentVle AS T2 ON T1.id_student = T2.id_student AND T1.code_module = T2.code_module AND T1.code_presentation = T2.code_presentation WHERE T1.final_result = 'Fail' GROUP BY T1.id_student, T1.code_module, T1.code_presentation) AS t
